notes.title: Pizza Time Explosion Special Update - Available Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217646/4dd92384e1c4b00d2d11363e85f104d79755d037.jpg[/img]
[h3][b]Pizza Time Explosion Special[/b] is finally here![/h3]

[previewyoutube=3mpNcx_7N90;full][/previewyoutube]

Pizza Time Explosion Special is a big update to the game, featuring three new modes! 

[b]Zombie Mode[/b] pits you against increasing hordes of zombies that have invaded the Pizza Dimension! Get in there and shoot pepperoni to fight them off! And don't worry, Ella will be there for backup with the Pizza Time truck!

[b]Photo Mode[/b] is a cute little image editor that Ella shares with you during a well-earned break from all the work you've been doing. Make pictures and use stickers from the game! You might get lost in a daydream while playing this mode...

In [b]Trash Chomper Mode[/b], you'll be using your Trash Chomper powerup to help Ella clean up some of the garbage that's ended up in the Pizza Dimension! Strangely, garbage seems to turn into candy over time here, so watch out for flies that have turned into jawbreakers!

Plus, the game is now on sale for 50% ($2.99) for one week (until Sep 27, 2020 at 10:00 AM)! Hope everyone enjoys this update, and for new players, I hope you enjoy the whole game!

notes.title: Pizza Time Explosion Update Beta now Available!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217646/683c034524b339837b90d7cfa6228efeabf25507.png[/img]

Pizza Time Explosion's big update is now available in Beta!

Changes include: 
[list]
[*] Zombie Mode is fully added (it's just missing some fun bells and whistles such as more ending cutscenes)
[*] The game's controls (for controllers) have been changed a bit, you now just move the analog stick to move, and hold down the A button to stay still
[*] The menu for the game's new Special Modes has been fully added, and although only Zombie Mode is in so far, you can check out sneak peaks for the others!
[/list]

If you're interested in trying this out and potentially helping with testing and/or looking for bugs, just right click on the game in your library and select 'Properties', and then the 'BETAS' tab, and then select to opt into the beta branch from the drop down menu! (No code is needed)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217646/e3d1adcb0c798c0c9ab907638faebd6579f7d7db.png[/img]

Hope you all enjoy this and look forward to the full update!

notes.title: Pizza Time Explosion is Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36217646/723435249f9270d6cf2898a60fe15802272e9629.png[/img]
The time has finally come, Pizza Time Explosion is out now on Steam! 

With the Steam release of the game comes a few new features:
[list]
[*]New solid color backgrounds available by default (check out page two of the Backgrounds menu in Extras!)
[*]A new powerup for endless modes (the Trash Chomper)
[*]26 Steam Achievements to unlcock
[*]Online leaderboards!
[/list]

We've been hard at work on these new features (and a few bugfixes) to get it ready before the game's launch, and I hope you're all excited and ready to enjoy them! See you in the Pizza Dimension!

Steam Launch Trailer:
[previewyoutube=YMe75OmMgzY;full][/previewyoutube]
